nodes.name: add_redispatch_dtts.sql
nodes.summary: Adds a nullable redispatch_dtts TIMESTAMPTZ column to delivery_summary so the re-dispatch timeout window resets on each pre-pickup rider decline, giving the new dispatch cycle a fresh timeout independent of the original order creation time.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses IF NOT EXISTS for idempotency; process_delivery uses COALESCE(redispatch_dtts, dtts) so existing rows fall back to original behavior automatically.

nodes.name: add_restaurant_confirmation_fields.sql
nodes.summary: Migrates delivery_summary to support the restaurant confirmation touchpoint: adds confirmation tracking columns, extends the status enum to include 'restaurant_unconfirmed', and installs a webhook trigger that fires an HTTP POST to the FastAPI endpoint when a new unconfirmed order is inserted.
nodes.languageNotes: Drops and recreates the status CHECK constraint to add the new value; creates a PL/pgSQL trigger function that reads ORDELO_APP_URL from ordelo_config with a hardcoded fallback URL.

nodes.name: admin_orders_indexes.sql
nodes.summary: Creates five performance indexes on delivery_summary, takeaway_summary, and order_item to support keyset pagination, London-timezone date-range filtering, and order-items lookup in the admin dashboard.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses functional indexes on COALESCE(pickup_time, dtts) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' to support London-local date filtering without recalculating at query time; comment notes CONCURRENTLY must be used per-statement in production.

nodes.name: admin_orders_views.sql
nodes.summary: Defines four CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW statements (v_admin_orders, v_admin_order_items, v_admin_orders_daily, v_admin_orders_monthly) that back the admin dashboard orders API, unioning delivery and takeaway summaries with financial data and pre-aggregating daily and monthly KPIs.
nodes.languageNotes: v_admin_orders_daily and v_admin_orders_monthly chain off v_admin_orders, so the indexes in admin_orders_indexes.sql must be applied first for optimal query plans.

nodes.name: create_cust_rest_map.sql
nodes.summary: Creates the cust_rest_map table with a composite primary key of (cust_id, rest_ref), tracking per-customer per-restaurant consent state with foreign keys to customer_master and restaurant_master.
